profile.description: Compatibility with a limited set of Classical tonal conventions

rules.rationale: Existing complete in-reference surface collections support a bounded tonal description.
rules.supportive_predicate: Qualified episode: checked chord/Roman; mapped function or context_dependent_function; no blocking surface flags.
rules.conflicting_predicate: None; unfamiliar collections are never negative style evidence.
rules.unavailable_predicate: Unknown/skipped shape, Roman or function prerequisite; uncertain key; blocked surface context.
limitations: Surface collection is not structural harmony.
Inversion and reattack variants do not multiply episodes.

rules.description: Existing tonic, predominant or dominant mappings
rules.rationale: Retain mapped branches without inferring a progression or independent votes.
rules.supportive_predicate: One counted episode with an existing tonic, predominant or dominant branch.
rules.conflicting_predicate: None; unknown function is never a conflicting progression.
rules.unavailable_predicate: Unknown/skipped function or unusable key; context-dependent recognition supplies no function support.
limitations: No applied function or local key is inferred.
Natural-minor v is not promoted to dominant.

rules.rationale: Observed endings supply bounded candidate evidence.
rules.supportive_predicate: Existing authentic, half, deceptive or plagal candidate with matching source/target and actual ending cue.
rules.conflicting_predicate: None; missing candidates are never improper endings.
rules.unavailable_predicate: Missing/uncertain key, missing cue or upstream deferral.
limitations: Candidates do not establish phrase significance.
Continuous V–I supplies no new candidate.

rules.rationale: The independent-voice convention treats existing positive relations as contextual tensions.
rules.supportive_predicate: None; checked negatives are not affirmative style support.
rules.conflicting_predicate: One distinct existing M3 positive transition, including its full before/after identity.
limitations: May be intentional and needs context.
No hidden/direct or enharmonic predicate is added.

rules.rationale: The independent-voice convention treats existing positive relations as contextual tensions.
rules.supportive_predicate: None; checked negatives are not affirmative style support.
rules.conflicting_predicate: One distinct existing M3 positive transition, including its full before/after identity.
limitations: May be intentional and needs context.
Unison is not recast as an octave.

rules.rationale: Immediate conventional resolutions support the convention; existing warnings request contextual review.
rules.supportive_predicate: One unique resolved obligation in an interpretable existing M3 context.
rules.conflicting_predicate: One unique nonconventional outcome attached to an M3 theory_issue diagnostic.
rules.unavailable_predicate: Unknown, held, delayed, exceptional, rest/gap, blocked or uncertain-key outcomes.
limitations: No remote successor or new warning is inferred.
Equivalent limitation/diagnostic copies form one observation.

assumptions: One global M2 reference; no local-key tracking.
M3 surface collections are not structural harmony.
Independent voices only where M3 supports them; source spelling and concert pitch retained.
Actual M3 ending cues required; incomplete contexts remain incomplete.
Provisional engineering convention; one supported profile, no comparison against other styles.
Selected key, recognized chord or supported cadence alone does not establish compatibility.

style_analysis.explanation: The available evidence meets the limited Classical compatibility convention. This does not establish a unique style, composer, authorship or musical quality. Supported features coexist with potentially intentional departures.
